extDescription: A swarm of cursors rebuilds the page in front of you. Open PDFs, documents and 3D models in SwarmLoom Studio.
commandToggle: Rebuild this page or stop the swarm
menuOpenPage: Open this document in SwarmLoom Studio
reasonBrowserPage: This is a built-in browser page, and browsers don't let extensions change it.
reasonStore: Extension stores are protected, so extensions can't change them.
reasonExtensionPage: This page belongs to another extension.
reasonPdf: This PDF is shown by the browser's built-in viewer, which extensions can't change.
reasonViewSource: Source and reader views are protected pages.
reasonFileAccess: SwarmLoom isn't allowed to open local files yet.
reasonFileUnsupported: This browser doesn't let extensions open local files.
reasonBlocked: The browser blocked SwarmLoom on this page.
noticeIntro: Here is what you can do instead:
noticeOpenStudioHint: Rebuild this document in SwarmLoom Studio.
noticeOpenStudioHomeHint: Open SwarmLoom Studio and pick a sample, a file or a link.
noticeImportHint: Choose or drop a PDF, Word, Markdown, SVG, image or 3D file in Studio.
noticeCopyHint: Paste the link into Studio, or open it in a normal tab.
noticeCopyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link above and copy it by hand.
noticeFileAccessHelp: To allow it, open the extension's details and turn on "Allow access to file URLs".
errorEmpty: There is nothing on this page that can be rebuilt.
pickPrompt: Click the part of the page you want to rebuild. Press Esc to cancel.
optionsIntro: Changes are saved right away and apply the next time the swarm starts.
optShortcutHint: Press {shortcut} on any page to start or stop the swarm.
optShortcutNone: This browser has no extension shortcuts. Use the SwarmLoom button instead.
optFileAccessDenied: To rebuild local files, turn on "Allow access to file URLs" in the extension's details.
optFileAccessUnsupported: This browser doesn't let extensions open local files. Import them in Studio instead.
optPrivacy: SwarmLoom only runs on the page where you start it. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
welcomeTagline: Watch a swarm of cursors weave it into being.
welcomeDemoCaption: This card is rebuilt live by SwarmLoom.
welcomeTry: Try it on a demo page
welcomeHowClick: Click the SwarmLoom button in the toolbar on any page.
welcomeHowMenu: Or right-click a page, a link or an image and choose a SwarmLoom item.
welcomeHowStop: Click the button again or press Esc to stop. When the build is done, press Go live.
pinChrome: Click the puzzle icon at the right of the address bar, then the pin next to SwarmLoom.
pinChromiumOthers: Brave, Opera and Vivaldi work the same way: open the extensions menu next to the address bar and pin SwarmLoom.
pinEdge: Click the Extensions icon next to the address bar, then the eye icon next to SwarmLoom.
pinFirefox: Click the Extensions button in the toolbar, then the gear next to SwarmLoom, and choose Pin to Toolbar.
pinFirefoxAndroid: Open the browser menu, tap Extensions, then tap SwarmLoom.
pinSafariMac: In Safari, choose Settings, then Extensions, and turn on SwarmLoom. Use View, then Customize Toolbar to move the button.
pinSafariIos: Tap the page menu in the address bar, then tap SwarmLoom. Allow it on the sites you want.
welcomeStudioHint: Rebuild PDFs, Word documents, Markdown, slides, sheets, images and 3D models.
demoBanner: This is a SwarmLoom demo page.
demoHint: You can also click the SwarmLoom button or press {shortcut}.
